headline: India box office: Dhurandhar: The Revenge leads at ₹1,820 Cr worldwide
lede: Dhurandhar: The Revenge leads the current IBO consensus board at ₹1,820 Cr worldwide, including ₹1,108.1 Cr in India nett.
